SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Application
Entry point of the spreadsheet application.
Cell
 
CellFactory
Factory for creating Cell instances from raw string data.
CloseCommand
Command that closes the currently open spreadsheet file.
Command
Represents a single user command in the spreadsheet application.
CommandContext
Holds the shared mutable state of the running spreadsheet application.
CommandProcessor
Parses and dispatches raw user input to the appropriate Command.
DoubleCell
A Cell that holds a double-precision floating-point value.
EditCommand
Command that sets or replaces the content of a specific spreadsheet cell.
EmptyCell
A Cell that contains no value.
ExitCommand
Command that signals the application to terminate.
FormulaCell
A Cell that holds an arithmetic formula.
HelpCommand
Command that prints a summary of all available commands and their syntax.
IntCell
A Cell that holds an integer value.
OpenCommand
Command that opens a spreadsheet file for editing.
PrintCommand
Command that prints the contents of the currently open spreadsheet to the console.
SaveAsCommand
Command that saves the current spreadsheet to a new file path.
SaveCommand
Command that saves the current spreadsheet to its existing file path.
Spreadsheet
The spreadsheet is modelled as a list of rows, each row being a list of Cell objects.
StringCell
A Cell that holds a plain-text string value.
